en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Yaqoub Bin Yazeed, from Muhammad Bin Shuayb, from Abu Kahmas, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘Six (things) attach to the Believer after his death – a child who seeks Forgiveness for him, and a book he leaves behind, and a plant which he plants, and a well which he digs, and a charity which he makes to flow, and a Sunnah which is taken with (acted upon) from after it’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Shu’ayb from abu Kahmas who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

Six things follow a believing deceased after his death: a child that asks forgiveness for him, a book that he leaves behind, a plantation that he plants, a well that he digs, a charity that he establishes and a Sunnah which is acted upon after his death/”
